data.narrative:
Wardstone is a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Sebastian Fischer and Tobias Fischer that has raised $5M to date. The valuation universe includes 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning the sector, including SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Stage-progression analysis serves as the sole applicable triangulation method. Using total capital raised ($5M) as a proxy baseline and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $212M. The public comp set trades at a median P/S multiple of 23.9x across the Space & Aerospace sector, but this method cannot be applied without Wardstone's revenue figures, which are not disclosed. Peer-median analysis was also inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable datapoints within the narrow peer cohort.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $181M to $244M, centered on $212M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. The primary uncertainty stems from reliance on a single valuation method and the absence of revenue data precluding public multiple anchoring. A more robust conclusion would require either disclosed revenue figures to calibrate public multiples or disclosure of financing terms from Wardstone's most recent round.
